plain.li: [persuading,otherfaith:wavering] You've seemed unsettled lately, and I know that feeling well.
[persuading,otherfaith:wavering] You don't have to carry your doubts alone, you know.
[persuading,myfaith] Can I tell you what {SUBJECT} means to me, just so you know?
[persuading,myfaith] {SUBJECT} has never once let me down, and I've tested it.
[persuading,friends] We've been through a lot together, so I'd like you to know what I believe.
[persuading] I'd like to tell you why I believe what I do, and you can laugh after.
[persuading,debate] Go on, give me your best argument, I've heard most of them.
[faith:wavering] I used to be so sure of it all, and lately I can't find my footing.
[faith:wavering,otherideo] How do you stay so certain, honestly?
[faith:wavering,sameideo] Do you ever kneel and feel nothing at all?
[faith:wavering] I stood at the back of the rite and couldn't make myself go closer.
[faith:wavering,otherfaith:devout] You always look so sure at the rites, what's that like?
[faith:alone,myfaith] I'm the only one here who keeps {SUBJECT}, and some nights it's lonely.
[faith:alone] Nobody here prays the way I do, so I say the words out loud to hear them.
[faith:minority,otherideo] It's not easy, keeping a faith most of the colony doesn't share.
[faith:minority,myfaith] Hardly anyone here keeps {SUBJECT}, and I mind more than I let on.
[faith:majority,otherideo] I hope you never feel shut out, keeping a different faith from most of us.
[faith:devout,sameideo] I'm glad of you at the rites, it's easier to hold on with someone beside me.
[steadied,faith:devout] Nothing out here is certain except this, and I'm glad we share it.
[steadied] I said the old words this morning and thought of you saying them too.
[nopreaching,otherideo] I'll tell you what I believe if you ask, but I won't push it on you.
[nopreaching] Where I come from, you keep your faith and let others keep theirs.
[digin,faith:devout] I'll say it plainly: I'm not ashamed of what I believe.
[digin,otherideo] I've seen how your lot do things, and I can't say I'm impressed.

warm.li: [persuading] I pray for you, you know, and I'd love it if one day you prayed with me.
[persuading,otherfaith:wavering] Whatever's troubling you, there's room for you at our rites.
[faith:wavering] I miss being sure, and I'd give a lot to feel it again.
[faith:alone] It would mean a lot if someone sat with me at a rite one day, even just to watch.

blunt.li: [persuading] Your faith's done nothing for you that I can see, and mine might.
[digin] Let's not pretend we'll agree on this.
[faith:wavering] I don't know what I believe any more, and I'm tired of pretending I do.

cheerful.li: [persuading] Come to one rite with us, and if you hate it I'll do your laundry for a week.
[faith:alone] Being the only one of my faith here means I always get the best seat at the rites.
[steadied,sameideo] Good rite this morning, and I only nodded off once.

gloomy.li: [faith:wavering] Some days the faith holds me up, and some days it holds me down.
[persuading] Out here, faith is the only thing that doesn't run out, think about it.

cold.li: [persuading] I can set out the case for what I believe, if you'll hear it to the end.
[digin] Your faith and mine contradict each other on most points, and I won't pretend otherwise.

plain.li: [persuaded] I hadn't thought of it like that.
[persuaded,theirfaith] Maybe there's more to {SUBJECT} than I gave it credit for.
[persuaded,faith:wavering] That's the first thing in weeks that's made any sense to me.
[persuaded,friends] Coming from you, I'll listen, so go on.
[persuaded] You say it like you've never doubted it once, and I envy that.
[persuaded,agree] Funny, I've thought the same and never said it.
[unmoved] I hear you, but I'm staying where I am.
[unmoved,faith:devout] That's well said, but it isn't enough.
[unmoved] I'll grant you that one point, and just the one.
[preachedat] Where I come from we don't press our faith on people, so don't press yours.
[preachedat] I didn't ask to be preached at.
[preachedat,theirfaith] I know what {SUBJECT} teaches without hearing it over supper.
[persuading,otherfaith:wavering] Doubt isn't the end of faith, sometimes it's the door to it.
[persuading] What I have, I'd share with anyone who asked, and you're asking in your way.
[persuading,otherfaith:wavering] Whatever you lost hold of, you can find again, I did.
[persuading,debate] You make a fair point, so let me make a better one.
[digin,otherideo] You won't talk me out of mine, and I won't try to talk you out of yours.
[digin,faith:devout] I've held to this through worse than you.
[digin] The more you push, the surer I get.
[digin,theirfaith] I've heard enough about {SUBJECT} for one lifetime.
[steadied] It helps to hear someone say it out loud.
[steadied,faith:wavering] I'd been slipping, and this helps more than you know.
[steadied,myfaith] {SUBJECT} has carried us this far, and it'll carry us further.
[faith:wavering,sameideo] I want to believe you, so give me time.
[faith:alone,otherideo] You're kind to ask, nobody else here does.

warm.li: [persuaded] You care about this, and about me, and that counts for something.
[persuading] I'm not trying to take anything from you, only to give you something.
[steadied] I'm glad it's you I share this with.
[preachedat] I know you mean well, but please don't.

blunt.li: [persuaded] Fine, you've got a point, don't let it go to your head.

cheerful.li: [persuaded] Keep talking like that and I'll be at your rites by spring.
[unmoved] Very convincing, and I'll think it over in the next life.
[steadied] Between the two of us, we've nearly got the whole thing worked out.

gloomy.li: [persuaded,faith:wavering] I've nothing else to hold on to, so maybe yours will do.
[digin] Believe what you like, we'll both be dust in the end.

cold.li: [persuaded] That is a better argument than I expected, and I'll consider it.
[unmoved] Your reasoning is sound until the last step.
[preachedat] I don't recall inviting a sermon.

plain.li: [persuading] Think on it, that's all I ask.
[persuading,myfaith] The door of {SUBJECT} is open whenever you want it.
[persuading] Come to the next rite and stand at the back, if you like.
[persuaded] You've given me a lot to think about.
[persuaded,faith:wavering] I'll sleep on it, and I might even sleep, for once.
[unmoved] I'll think about it, but don't wait up.
[preachedat] Let's leave it there, before one of us says something.
[digin] Well, neither of us is moving tonight.
[digin] We'll each keep our own, then.
[steadied] Same time at the next rite, then.
[steadied,faith:devout] Hold fast, and so will I.

warm.li: [persuading] Whatever you decide, you're welcome at our rites.
[persuaded] Thank you for not pushing, it made it easier to listen.

blunt.li: [digin] Done talking, I know what I believe.

cheerful.li: [persuading] One rite, and I'll save you a seat and won't even make you sing.

cold.li: [persuading] Consider it at your leisure, the argument will keep.

plain.li: [persuaded] I'll think on it, and I mean that.
[persuaded,theirfaith] Maybe I'll come and see one of your rites, just to see.
[persuaded] Nobody's ever put it to me like that before.
[unmoved] Good night, and I'm keeping my own faith, thank you.
[preachedat] Next time, ask before you start.
[persuading] You know where to find me.
[persuading,otherfaith:wavering] Don't be afraid of the doubt, just don't be alone with it.
[digin] Suit yourself.
[digin,faith:devout] I'll pray for you anyway, so don't argue.
[steadied] Thank you, I needed that.

warm.li: [persuaded] Thank you for caring enough to say all that.

gloomy.li: [persuaded] I'll try it, what's one more thing to lose.
